_comment: Passkeys, the signed-in user's passkeys page (generic passkeys page PRD D1), shipped by
MintPlayer.Spark.Authorization (composition D6). A virtual page: no clrType, no documents.
PasskeysActions.OnLoadAsync scaffolds it per request for the caller, ignores the id (the route
is /po/passkeys/me) and 404s when nobody is signed in or SparkPasskeys is Disabled.
HAND-AUTHORED. The ids are UUIDv5 of 'authorization:Passkeys[.attributes.<Name>]' (D5), verified
Description is the explanatory paragraph, filled from auth.passkeysDescription and drawn by the
core 'paragraph' renderer (full width, no label). The my-passkeys grid below is declared on
PasskeyRow.json; the three actions and their rights ship in this library's actions.json and
security.json, so an application states nothing to have the page.
